channel.title: VISIONE Wire
channel.description: Global news, gaming, entertainment, business, markets, technology, artificial intelligence, policy and culture from VISIONE Wire.

item.title: AI security market to reach $4.8 billion in 2027, Gartner forecasts
item.description: Gartner forecasts spending on securing AI will rise 68.7% to $4.783 billion in 2027 as agentic AI, prompt injection and access-control risk expand the market.

item.title: Stability AI raises $76 million from EA, Sony Music, Universal, Warner and others
item.description: Stability AI raised a $76 million Series B backed by Electronic Arts, Sony Music Group, Universal Music Group, Warner Music Group and other investors.

item.title: Nvidia releases DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction with Gamescom RTX push
item.description: Nvidia released DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction with a second-generation transformer model and a wave of new Gamescom RTX integrations.

item.title: OpenAI says Jalapeño chip beats leading AI accelerators on speed and efficiency
item.description: OpenAI published the first measured results for Jalapeño, its custom inference chip, claiming higher throughput per watt and lower latency across GPT-OSS, DeepSeek R1 and Kimi K2.5.

item.title: Gamescom Award 2026 nominees: Metro 2039 leads, Alien: Isolation 2 and Denshattack! follow
item.description: Metro 2039 leads the official Gamescom Award 2026 nominations with five nods; Alien: Isolation 2 and Denshattack! have four each, with public voting opening August 26.

item.title: Gamescom 2026 Opening Night Live: Witcher 3 Remastered, Songs of the Past and biggest reveals
item.description: Updated August 26: The Witcher 3 Remastered launches September 29 as a free upgrade, while Songs of the Past reveals Letten, Switch 2 support and a 2027 release window.

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 beta: new movement, maps and open beta dates
item.description: Infinity Ward is testing a faster, more fluid version of grounded Call of Duty multiplayer before the public open beta begins August 28.

item.title: Thomson Reuters launches proprietary AI model after $40 million build
item.description: Thomson Reuters has launched Thomson, its first proprietary large language model, after a $40 million build focused on legal, tax and professional work.

item.title: Star Wars Zero Company launches August 27: release time, platforms and final trailer
item.description: Star Wars Zero Company launches August 27 on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Here is the confirmed release time, story, gameplay, cast and final trailer.

item.title: Gold climbs above $4,640 as August rally nears 15%
item.description: Gold rose above $4,640 an ounce on August 24, extending an August rally of roughly 15% as dollar weakness, fiscal concerns and geopolitical risk drive demand.

item.title: Germany games market falls 3% to €4.2 billion in first half of 2026
item.description: Germany's games market generated €4.2 billion in the first half of 2026, down 3% year over year, as gamescom opens against a mixed industry backdrop.

item.title: Alibaba launches HK$80 billion share placement to fund full-stack AI push
item.description: Alibaba is raising HK$80 billion, about US$10.2 billion, in Hong Kong and says 100% of net proceeds will fund its full-stack AI capabilities and infrastructure.

item.title: Nvidia customers face AI server price hikes above 15% as memory costs climb
item.description: Nvidia customers have reportedly been told to expect AI server price increases above 15% on systems shipping in early 2027 as advanced memory costs surge.

item.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol API pricing by more than 20% for three months
item.description: OpenAI has cut GPT-5.6 Sol API and credit pricing by more than 20% for three months, extending its price-performance push to the flagship GPT-5.6 tier.

item.title: US-Iran sanctions showdown puts Hormuz and oil back at center of markets
item.description: The US is preparing new Iran sanctions for August 24 as Hormuz traffic remains severely constrained and oil markets price renewed geopolitical risk.

item.title: Nvidia earnings on August 26 will test the AI rally: what to watch
item.description: Nvidia reports fiscal Q2 2027 results on August 26 after guiding to $91 billion in revenue, making the release a major test for AI spending and markets.

item.title: Kryvyi Rih shopping-centre strike kills at least 16 as Ukraine says rescuers were targeted in second wave
item.description: At least 16 people were killed and 130 injured after two drone strikes hit a shopping centre in Kryvyi Rih; Ukrainian officials say the second wave endangered rescuers.

item.title: Broadcom seeks more than $60 billion for AI buildout as debt markets start to strain
item.description: Broadcom is reportedly seeking more than $60 billion for AI infrastructure as a record wave of technology debt tests investor appetite.

item.title: Prime Video commits more than $2 billion to Latin America through 2030
item.description: Prime Video will invest more than $2 billion in Latin America from 2027 through 2030, expanding local originals, sports and regional services.

item.title: Bond yields rebound after Treasury buyback push as markets brace for Jackson Hole
item.description: Long-term US yields rebound as investors weigh Treasury buybacks, inflation, Iran-war energy costs and the Fed.

item.title: Brazil commits R$2.3 billion to AI supercomputing with US and Chinese technology
item.description: Brazil is committing roughly R$2.3 billion to AI supercomputing projects spanning US- and China-linked technology.

item.title: NYCC 2026 panel slate brings Marvel TV, Crystal Lake, Final Fantasy VII Revelation and more
item.description: New York Comic Con reveals a major 20th anniversary panel slate across Marvel, horror, gaming and anime.

item.title: Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15: price, gameplay, accessibility and pre-order details
item.description: Insomniac’s Wolverine launches September 15 on PS5 with pre-orders and extensive accessibility support.

item.title: Outer Banks Season 5 premieres August 20: final season, story and what to know
item.description: Outer Banks returns for its fifth and final season on Netflix August 20.

item.title: GTA VI extended look is set for August 27: what Rockstar has confirmed
item.description: Rockstar has scheduled an extended look at GTA VI for August 27 at 3 PM ET.

item.title: OpenAI tightens controls around Astra after tests raise critical cyber concerns
item.description: OpenAI says it cannot rule out critical cybersecurity capabilities in Astra.

item.title: Google gets option for $12.2 billion Marvell stake in sweeping AI chip deal
item.description: Google and Marvell expand their custom AI chip relationship in a deal that includes a large stock warrant.
